text.tspan: What you build: a cable (parts A, C, D), then a switch (part B)
Parts A, C, D · two PCs and a cable
A · ping pc2: ARP first (0.232 ms), then ~0.04 ms
the only route is 192.168.10.0/24: no gateway
D · tc tbf rate 10mbit on veth-pc1
pings slow down while the link is full
Part B · three PCs and a switch
First delete Part A's pc1 and pc2: the names are reused
Order in this lab: A → C → D (same two PCs) → delete them → B → cleanup
